question.text: Under SEBI ICDR, how many working days before the opening of a rights issue must the abridged letter of offer and application form be despatched to eligible shareholders?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI ICDR, the abridged letter of offer along with the application form must be despatched to eligible shareholders at least 3 working days before the opening of the rights issue. This timeline gives shareholders enough lead time to receive the offer material and decide whether to subscribe before the issue opens. The Trap: The same source page discusses the announcement of the record date separately, with reference to the SEBI LODR timelines rather than a 3-working-day rule, so this 3-working-day requirement applies to despatch of the offer document, not to the record-date announcement itself. Note: Tie the 3-working-day rule to the despatch of the abridged letter of offer and application form. Keep the record-date announcement timeline as a separate point governed by SEBI LODR.
